items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Max Hammond let him go, got Earl back... we got Bird... Jay and I went away to Chicago... we left the band under the control of William Scott

ctx.x: And we'd sing it there, and sometimes we'd do it on the radio. Nobody ever bothered it. But it was chicken in the basket, and how it would knock you out. So people were coming from all over. I mean, the right society of people, because they wouldn't let a bum in there, you know. They -- everybody would come in and you'd see them order chicken in the basket. Turned out to And that would be a great thing. McShann And during that time Max Hammond (PHONETIC) was so popular we got that thing called the Vine Street…

one show. But we'd go on with McShann's group. They had a comedian, couple of singers around. And maybe a shake at that place. dance or something, you know. On the stage there. And McShann's popularity just grew. People down at the radio station, everybody was trying to get McShann. Then Dave Dexter met him and he fell in love with him. From there on, McShann was making it.
